stock.description: Angelalign Technology Inc. functions as an investment holding enterprise primarily dedicated to the innovation, production, and distribution of clear aligner solutions for orthodontic treatment throughout China. Their key offerings, Angel Aligner Pro and Angel Aligner Classic, are bespoke, removable clear aligners designed to gradually guide a patient's teeth into proper alignment over time. Beyond aligner development, the company also operates dental clinics that provide a variety of services, including orthodontics and cosmetic dentistry, and distributes intraoral scanners. Their extensive portfolio of clear aligner brands features Angelalign, Angelalign Pro, Angelalign Kid, and COMFOS. The firm was founded in 2003 and maintains its principal offices in Shanghai, China.
